# Scientific American (SciAm)

> > Scientific American's subscription and access information, covering digital and print magazine plans, institutional licensing, and platform availability across iOS and Android.

This site provides information about Scientific American (SciAm) subscription options, published by Springer Nature America, Inc. It includes details on pricing plans, promotional offers, and legal terms for accessing the world's leading science magazine.
